Statement used in this study: Model-attributed temperature-driven load, Σt ΔLheat,t, not total load
PV energy allocated to offset that load in the same interval under a stated rule (heat priority, proportional, order-averaged or base-load priority)

Self-consumption gives the share of PV output used on site; it does not show how much of that PV offsets temperature-driven load. Here it was 99.8–100% in every season and year, so it cannot discriminate between hedging outcomes

Self-sufficiency (and the solar fraction) uses total load as its base and does not separate temperature-driven load from base load. SHHRpr/SS gives the coincidence enrichment, i.e. how much better PV is aligned with temperature-driven load than with load in general
